name: TypeSafe
description: Ask the Jev model yes/no, multiple-choice and scoring questions and get calibrated answers.

methods.label: Connect with an API key
methods.whenToUse: Use a TypeSafe API key so agents can ask Jev typed questions.
methods.guidanceMd: Create an API key in your TypeSafe account and paste it here. Agents you select can then ask Jev questions about text or data from their tasks.
warnings: Content an agent submits for evaluation is sent to TypeSafe. Grant access only to agents whose task content may leave this instance.
